points.quote: unauthorised and / or unacknowledged use of artificial intelligence tools to generate content for assessment purposes
points.gist: Unauthorised or unacknowledged use of AI tools to generate content for assessment is an example of inappropriate use of digital information.

points.quote: using such technology without explicit permission from relevant academic staff and / or not acknowledging use of such technology when its use is permitted.
points.gist: Using such technology without explicit permission from academic staff, or not acknowledging it when permitted, is misconduct.

points.quote: unauthorised and / or unacknowledged use of paraphrasing or translation software to, for example, disguise plagiarism, collusion, contract cheating or other academic integrity breach.
points.gist: Unauthorised or unacknowledged paraphrasing or translation software used to disguise plagiarism, collusion or contract cheating is an example of misconduct.

points.quote: It is noted that the UCD Plagiarism Tariff is not appropriate for guiding penalties in relation to other categories of academic misconduct, such as the unauthorised use of generative AI.
points.gist: The UCD Plagiarism Tariff is not appropriate for guiding penalties for other categories of misconduct such as unauthorised use of generative AI.
